name: Onboarding — de la landing de planes a los módulos del negocio
description: Un visitante nuevo entra desde /planes, crea su cuenta, verifica su correo con el código mostrado en pantalla, elige el plan Negocio sin promoción, da de alta su negocio con un nombre único, y llega al hub de módulos que muestra ese mismo nombre de negocio.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the plans landing page
Verify the plans landing page shows the heading about administering a business and a 'Crear mi cuenta gratis' call to action
Click 'Crear mi cuenta gratis' to go to the registration page
Fill the registration form with a unique full name, a unique email address, and a password of at least 8 characters in both the password and confirm password fields
Type the same full name into the signature field for the terms acceptance
Check the checkbox agreeing to the Terms and Conditions
Submit the registration form by clicking 'Crear cuenta'
Verify the browser navigates to the verify email page showing a 6-digit code entry and the email address just registered
Read the development verification code shown on the verify email page and type its 6 digits into the code input boxes
Submit the verification code by clicking 'Verificar código'
Verify the browser navigates to the select-plan page showing a grid of plan cards including a 'Negocio' plan card
Click 'Continuar' without entering a promotional code
Verify the confirm-plan page shows the trial status 'Prueba gratuita' and a 'Crear negocio' button, with no applied promo code shown
Click 'Crear negocio' to go to the business setup page
Fill the business name field with a unique business name
Verify the browser navigates to the modules hub page and shows a heading confirming that the exact business name just entered is configured
